arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test with empty result
r_empty = parse.parse('', '')
print('Empty result:', r_empty)
print('fixed:', r_empty.fixed)
print('named:', r_empty.named)
print(\"'anything' in r_empty:\", 'anything' in r_empty)

# Test with mixed fixed and named
r_mixed = parse.parse('{} and {name}', 'foo and bar')
print()
print('Mixed result:', r_mixed)
print('fixed:', r_mixed.fixed)
print('named:', r_mixed.named)
print(\"'foo' in r_mixed:\", 'foo' in r_mixed)
print(\"'bar' in r_mixed:\", 'bar' in r_mixed)
print(\"'name' in r_mixed:\", 'name' in r_mixed)
print(\"'0' in r_mixed:\", '0' in r_mixed)
print(\"0 in r_mixed:\", 0 in r_mixed)

# Test with numbers as values
r_nums = parse.parse('{} is {}', '123 is 456')
print()
print('Numbers result:', r_nums)
print('fixed:', r_nums.fixed)
print('named:', r_nums.named)
print(\"123 in r_nums:\", 123 in r_nums)
print(\"'123' in r_nums:\", '123' in r_nums)
"
